name: Makro
owner: InRetail Perú Corp. (Intercorp group) — Makro Supermayorista S.A. (acquired from SHV, Dec 2020)

logoSources.notes: Official yellow 'makro' wordmark (#FFD206) served by InRetail's plazavea.com.pe for its Makro tab, rasterized with headless Chrome and centred on #26469D, the blue of makro.pe's own touch icon https://www.makro.pe/assets/favicon/apple-touch-icon.png (yellow 'm' on blue). Alternative symbol: that 'm' icon (also https://www.makro.pe/assets/favicon/android-chrome-256x256.png); the full wordmark was preferred because it is still legible at 40 px and more recognizable.
Official blue 'makro' wordmark (#00269A), transparent, trimmed, 512 px wide (reads on the white card).
Wikidata P154 'Latin America' logo is the old red SHV-era wordmark — not the current Peruvian identity, not used.

notes: Cash & carry / wholesale ('supermayorista'). InRetail bought Makro Supermayorista S.A. from SHV Group; InRetail's corporate presentation dates the acquisition 23 Dec 2020. Store count: InRetail Q2'26 earnings presentation, Food Retail 'Cash & Carry' = 27 stores at 30 Jun 2026 (unchanged since Q2'25); Perú Retail (8 May 2026) also says 27. legendName is 'MAKRO' by default; the user's slides label it 'CASH & CARRY' (editable). makro.pe/tiendas lists the stores by name (e.g. Makro Callao, Chiclayo, Chimbote, Cusco, Huancayo, El Bosque, Yanahuara, Santa Anita, Surco). OSM (probe 2026-10-01): 24 shop=wholesale objects match, 23 already carry brand:wikidata=Q704606 (NSI: Makro worldwide brand, all countries except TH). Excluded: 'MAKRO DE San Juan de Miraflores' (shop=hardware, unrelated), 'Fiesta Makro' (shop=yes), parkings, a CrediScotia agency, 'Makro - Promart' building.
